name: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd
title: Nucleus Software Exports Ltd - 531209 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue flat YoY at INR 224.77 crore while EBITDA fell to INR 34.62 crore from INR 74.33 crore; order book jumped to INR 1,044 crore but management gives no guidance and lost Bajaj Finance to a competitor.
